title: Section functor from transition maps
statement: Let J be a small category, F : J → Cat a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and P_j a precoverage on F(j), generating T_j [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume each F(a) is continuous for T_j and T_k. Fix i in J. For t in Under(i), write f_t = F(t.hom), S_t = (f_t)_s, and R_t = (f_t)^s, with unit η_t of S_t ⊣ R_t [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction]. For b : t → t′ write R_b = F(b.right)^s; restrictions satisfy R_b followed by R_t = R_t′, up to the equality induced by F.map_comp and t.hom ≫ b.right = t′.hom. Fix U in F(i) and suppose natural transformations θ_b : S_t → S_t′ followed by R_b are given, satisfying Arrow.mk(eta_t(G)_X followed by theta_b(G) at f_t(X)) = Arrow.mk(eta_t′(G)_X) at every G and every X in F(i). There exist L : Sh(T_i, Set) → (Under(i) → Set) and natural isomorphisms E_t : L(-)(t) ≅ S_t(-)(f_t(U)), such that E_t(G) followed by θ_b(G) at f_t(U) equals L(G)(b) followed by E_t′(G) as arrow objects. This statement constructs L and E from the given θ; it does not assert existence of θ.

proof.text: Use the hypothesis at all X to obtain the sheaf adjunct equation after the canonical restriction transports. Injectivity of homEquiv shows that it uniquely determines each theta_b(G). The transported identity has the same adjunct for an identity refinement. For b followed by c, the composite theta_b followed by restriction of theta_c has the same adjunct as theta for the composite, by the two given unit equations. Thus identity and composition hold.

For G define L(G)(t) = S_t(G)(f_t(U)). Evaluate theta_b(G) at f_t(U), then transport its codomain along F.map_comp and Under.w to define L(G)(b). The preceding coherence and cancellation of equality transports prove map_id and map_comp.

Define L on sheaf morphisms by evaluating the maps of S_t at f_t(U). Naturality of theta proves these are morphisms of diagrams, and functoriality of S_t gives the laws in G. The identity evaluation identifications define E. The definition of L(G)(b), with endpoint transports, gives the displayed Arrow equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A35 section formula and adjunction paragraph; coherence argument follows the existing proved ColimitSiteAbelianSectionDiagram, specialized to Type u and extended to naturality in G

theorem stage_section_functor_from_transitions
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (U : F.obj i)
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
        sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck ⟶
        sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck ⋙
          (F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
            (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck)
    (hθ : ∀ (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
        (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj i),
        Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app
            (op X) ≫ ((θ t t' b).app G).hom.app
              (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
        Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app
            (op X))) :
    ∃ (L : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u) ⥤ (Under i ⥤ Type u))
      (E : ∀ t : Under i, L ⋙ (evaluation (Under i) (Type u)).obj t ≅
        sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck ⋙
          sheafToPresheaf (P t.right).toGrothendieck (Type u) ⋙
          (evaluation (F.obj t.right)ᵒᵖ (Type u)).obj
            (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))),
      ∀ (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
        (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
        Arrow.mk ((E t).hom.app G ≫ ((θ t t' b).app G).hom.app
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
        Arrow.mk ((L.obj G).map b ≫ (E t').hom.app G)
